title: platform-objects: Create User's result dialog always says "Copy the temporary password now", though a typed password returns none to copy
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2207, the maintainer's browser round on ObjectStack 18.0.0 (「hotcrm 升级到 objectstack 18.0 然后重新安排一轮浏览器测试」). Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-02** of track 2 (the Setup pass as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01BkRPwuAufrFwoEEfuigDm9`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `16c28664` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 (framework `06cab4849`, console objectui `616df6598b42`), in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-v18-setup-pass` at `4d7cc467d` ([`REPORT.md`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md)), which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, Setup → Users → Create User.
- **Steps:** enter an email, a name and a password; Confirm.
- **Expected:** the field's own label, "Password (leave empty to generate)". Only a generated password needs showing once, as the generated case does ("Temporary Password ••••").
- **Actual:** the dialog reads "User Created — Copy the temporary password now — it is shown only once and never stored." It shows only the email, and its button is "I have saved this password". No password was generated, so there is nothing to copy, and the admin is left unsure whether the typed password was used.
- **Evidence:** [`07-people-users-created.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/07-people-users-created.png) (typed), [`07-people-users-created-generated-redacted.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/07-people-users-created-generated-redacted.png) (generated, for comparison).
- **Reach:** every admin who sets a user's first password.

## Seat review (source at 18.0.0, `06cab4849`)

- The copy is static metadata: `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts:263-264` (`description: 'Copy the temporary password now — it is shown only once and never stored.'`, `acknowledge: 'I have saved this password'`).
- The renderer is right: it skips `temporaryPassword` when the response has none (`:268`), so only the email shows.
- `ActionSchema.resultDialog` (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:1460`) has no per-outcome copy.
- The sibling `set_user_password` in the same file already hedges: "If a temporary password was generated, copy it now — it is shown only once and never stored." (`:326`).
- Not plugin-auth and not the objectui renderer (the tester's guess). Unchanged on `main`.

## Dedupe

Method: every objectstack-ai/objectstack issue title (every state, #1–#24932) and every objectstack-ai/objectui issue title (#7–#13268), listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint (refreshed with `since=2026-10-19`) and matched case-insensitively. The search API is refused for this session.
- Related, closed: objectstack#22821 (same action; fixed the ignored "Generate" checkbox, left this copy as it was).
- Different: objectstack#24758 (the password params are clear-text inputs); objectstack#3031; objectstack#3260.
- **New.**
